_comment: Demo students that give the leaderboard peers to measure against. Real-sounding display names; emails use the reserved .example TLD and the accounts carry random discarded passwords (cannot be logged into). Consumed by scripts/seed-demo-students.mjs (initial history), scripts/topup-demo-students.mjs (tops existing students up to seedTotal when a target is raised), and app/api/cron/demo-activity/route.ts (daily drip). seedTotal = target total questions (a floor the top-up enforces); perDay = average questions the drip adds each day.
